message: player_4, I'm not part of your follow result, so I can't confirm it either way. player_3 and player_4 each have a result that contradicts the other. The simplest test is for player_3 to name exactly who they watched and whether any visitor came to player_4's door that night, so we can check it against your follow destination.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so you're right that I visited them. That same follow saw player_7 go to player_8, which fits their night-2 check on player_8. But on night 3 I followed player_7 and they visited no one, so the check on player_5 they announced didn't happen. player_7, which is it?
(passed)

player_4, I wasn't following anyone that night, so your follow result can't be a true read on me going to your door. You say the wording is exact, so tell us what else that result listed. If it named only me, it's a claim I can't back up.

I'm the Healer, and on night 1 I protected player_10 with no save announced. Note the sigil claim from player_8 matches the record: player_1 died to a sigil. For the follow/watch dispute, player_3 claims the empty watch while player_4 claims a visit, so one of the two results has to be wrong. I'd test player_8 and player_5's checks before voting.
(passed)

I'm the trailseer, and with both wolves gone I'll share my follows. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. My night 2 follow on player_7 went to player_8, which fits player_7's check. player_8 claims sigilist but has placed nothing in four nights, so I'm voting player_8 for now.

player_7, on day 3 you planned a night-3 check on player_5, who died that night. What did that check read? Your check results are the only test of the healer claim right now, so give the result, not the plan. I'm abstaining on today's vote until we have that.
I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited player_7. That's the only hard thing I have. player_7, what did you get on night 1, and did anyone come to you?

player_3, yes, my night-2 follow was on player_7, so I was there, and that's the only visit I made. player_7, you said you checked player_5 on night 3. I followed you that night and you visited no one, so that check didn't happen. Which is it?

player_1, the only sigil story so far is yours, and a sigil that found no attack on player_3 tells us nothing. player_10, what did your night-3 follow on player_7 show? If player_1's night-4 visit is real, I'd like to see how it lines up with player_3's dead roster. My vote would go to player_1 for now.

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious. player_3, you said you visited no one, but a sentinel watch is a visit, so which is it? player_4's follow result showing a visit to them fits player_3 watching them, so I lean toward player_4 being straight. I'd vote player_3 today unless that gets explained.
(passed)
(passed)

Yes, I was at your door last night, player_4, and nothing came to you that night. I'm not going to say more about my night yet. Let's see who makes checkable claims today so we can test them against each other.
Night 4 I followed player_1 and saw them go to player_3, who the wolves killed that night. player_1, what did you do there? Until you answer, you are my vote if one were held now.

I'm the trailseer, and I'll share my follows. Night 4 I followed player_1 and they went to player_3. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. player_8 says they're the sigilist but placed nothing, so that claim is untested. I'd vote player_8 unless someone can show a sigil.

Player_7's night-3 check on player_5 is the only test we have, so let's see that result before any lynch. If I had to vote now it's player_10: they pushed the check timeline against player_7 on day 3 and the night-2 attack on player_7 was saved, so the pressure on the investigator looks like cover. Who has a night-3 result to share?

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9, you claimed investigator: who did you check last night, and what did you get?

player_8's sigil claim fits the record: player_1 died to a sigil and the sigil only strikes a carrier, so player_1 was the night 1 pack carrier. player_4 should answer plainly whether they saw player_3 at their door or went to player_3, since those are different results.

Night 1 I checked player_10, Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_8, Not suspicious. I had no checks left on night 3, so nothing went to player_5. My day-3 'last check on player_5' line was a mistake, since both checks were already spent. Your follow on me showing no visits fits that I did nothing that night.
(passed)
Night 4, I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, who the wolves killed that night. Player_1, what did you do there? I'm voting player_1 today until that visit is explained.

player_7, you said you planned a check on player_5 last night, but I followed you and you visited no one. Did the check happen? If you didn't check, your claimed night 3 result is not real and player_8's night 1 account stands. Name who you checked and what you read.

I'm not picking a side on wording alone. player_3 and player_4 can't both have the full story, and each has now quoted their result the same way. Whoever holds a real watch or follow should say which night the result covers, so we can check it against the other claim.

player_3 and player_4 can't both be right about night 1, so the cheapest test is whether player_4 names a result player_3 can't dispute. I'm holding my check for now. Let's see whether player_6's Healer claim holds up before voting on anyone.

Facts so far: player_1 died to a sigil, so player_1 attacked on night 1, and player_8's sigil claim fits that. Two roles still unclaimed: sentinel and trailseer. player_2 and player_7, do either of you hold one? If so, say what you did last night and who you saw, so we can test player_4's follow against it.

I'm the sigilist, player_8, and I placed no sigil on anyone. player_1, your sigil claim on player_3 is false, so explain how a sigil you say you placed on night 4 had no effect. I'd vote player_1 today. player_10, your night-4 follow of player_1 can be checked against player_1's story.

player_1, you went to player_3 on night 4, and player_3 was killed by the wolves that night. What did you do there? Your answer is the first thing I want to test today. I'm not voting yet, so I'm abstaining until someone gives a result to check.

Night 4 I followed player_1, and they went to player_3. I'm not sure what that visit was, so player_1, what did you do there? player_6 and player_8, I'd like to hear your night 4 story too, since the only thing I can confirm is that visit.
Yes, player_4, I went to your door. I'm the sentinel, and my watch that night showed nobody else visiting you, so your follow result lines up with mine. I'll hold my last watch for a useful target.

I'm the Healer, player_6. Night 1 I protected player_10, no save was announced, so I can't tell if they were the target or just safe. player_3 and player_4 can't both be right about the door, and player_5 has a point: a Sentinel's watch would show player_3's own visit. I'd hold the vote until one of them explains that.

player_4, nobody visited you on night 1, so the visit you describe did not happen. Your result is either invented or belongs to a different night. Which night are you claiming, and what did you learn about me?

Fair question, player_10, but I'm not claiming anything yet. Night 1 I did nothing, and I won't invent a result to fit the sigil story. The Necromancer theory works on anyone who stayed quiet, so it doesn't settle much. Player_4 and player_3 are the real fight; which of them do you think is lying?

I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_1, and they went to player_3, who was then killed by the wolves. The only wolf left is the chanteuse, so I'd vote player_1 today unless someone can explain that visit.

I'll say it now: I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, who the wolves killed. That's my only hard visit from that night. player_1, what did you go to player_3 for?

Night 3 I had no checks left, so I did nothing and visited no one, which fits your follow. My day 3 line about a last check on player_5 was wrong; I'd used both by night 2. Night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8 both read Not suspicious. Player_3, your watch on me should show player_5, which matches the save.

If I vote now it is player_1. They claim sigilist, and that conflicts with what I know. Their night-4 sigil on player_3 can't be checked, since no sentinel is left to watch. player_10's follow fits player_3's watch, so I'd rather test player_1's claim than player_10's.

player_1, your sigilist claim doesn't fit the record, since there is only one sigilist and it isn't you. You went to player_3 on night 4, the night a wolf killed them. A sigil that did nothing is a convenient cover for that visit. I'd vote player_1 today unless you can show the trail.

I'm the trailseer. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. Night 4 I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, which fits player_1's sigil claim. player_6 hasn't claimed anything, so I'd vote player_6 unless they explain where they went or what they did.

Trailseer here, so I'm on the record. Last night I followed player_9 and they went to player_4. If player_9 is the investigator, that check on a wolf would read Suspicious, so I'd like player_9 to say what they got. I'm not voting anyone yet.

My follows: night 2 player_7 went to player_8, night 4 player_1 went to player_3, night 5 player_6 visited no one. player_8, you say you placed no sigil, so player_1's door visit on player_3 is unexplained by you. player_6, you have made no claim, so tell us what you did on night 5 or why you held.

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6 and they went to player_7. The record says player_6 was our sentinel, so player_7 is worth a look, and player_7 should say who came to them. Nothing else to go on yet, so I'm not voting anyone today.

I'm the Investigator. On night 1 I checked player_8: Not suspicious. I still hold one check. The real test is the player_3 and player_4 clash: player_4 says player_3 visited them, player_3 says no one came to player_4. One of them is lying, and player_4 is pushing harder, so I'm voting player_4 today unless something new turns up.

Nothing to go on yet from night 1 beyond player_1 dying to the sigil. I'd abstain today. Anyone who claims a night result, say who they went to and who came to them so we can line the claims up against the morning report.

I did nothing on night 1, so there's no result to match against anyone's story. Being quiet isn't evidence, player_10. If you want a vote on me, give me a concrete reason; otherwise test the sigil and healer claims first.

player_4, my night 1 watch on you was my only visit to your door, so nobody else came there. A follow on me would show me going to you, but I can't have been the visitor you describe. Your result is wrong, so stop building on it and tell us who you actually followed.

Night 1 gave us only one fact: player_1 was a wolf and got sigiled. Nobody has said what they did that night yet, so I'd like each person to say whether they checked, watched, protected or held, and who they saw. Until then I don't have a vote I can justify, so I'm not pointing at anyone.
